title: Tracecat 1.1.0-alpha.6
body_markdown:
## Breaking changes


- feat(api)!: Consolidate invitations into one table with role grants ([#3453](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3453) )


## Case management


- fix(cases): Return 404 when removing an unattached tag ([#3642](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3642) )


## Tables


- fix(tables): Load parent metadata before column mutations ([#3649](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3649) )


## Agents


- feat(agents): Add GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1 to platform catalog ([#3593](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3593) )
- fix(agents): Tolerate unsigned thinking blocks in session history ([#3598](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3598) )
- docs(skills): Block database migrations in patch releases ([#3616](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3616) )
- fix(agents+mcp): Report current skill version on presets, never pin ([#3617](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3617) )
- fix(agents): Stop retrying user-denied tool calls after approval ([#3630](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3630) )
- fix(agents): Preserve cancellation during runtime teardown ([#3647](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3647) )
- feat(agents): Add Claude Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 to platform catalog ([#3651](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3651) )


## Core actions


- fix(actions): Cap malloc arenas in DuckDB action under RLIMIT_AS ([#3643](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3643) )


## Integrations


- feat(integrations): Add TypeSafe System One API template ([#3638](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3638) )
- fix(integrations): Handle OAuth token exchange failures ([#3648](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3648) )


## Engine


- fix(engine): Preserve errors with provenance-based secret masking ([#3600](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3600) )


## API


- feat(rbac): Synchronize membership with role changes ([#3394](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3394) )
- feat(rbac): Any role grants organization membership ([#3447](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3447) )
- feat(api+ui): Support AWS Secrets Manager as an external secret source ([#3498](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3498) )
- feat(api): Add Bitbucket workspace Git sync ([#3601](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3601) )
- fix(api): Return 422 for malformed workflow IDs ([#3639](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3639) )
- fix(ui+api): Count nested workflows in folder view header ([#3641](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3641) )


## Infrastructure


- fix(infra): Read Compose healthcheck ports from container env ([#3636](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3636) )
- feat(infra): Support disabling TLS verification for blob storage ([#3637](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3637) )
- fix(infra): Replace MinIO image with Chainguard in Compose files ([#3640](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3640) )


## Observability


- fix(logging): Preserve originating LLM proxy failure stacks ([#3442](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3442) )


## Build system


- build: Shrink app images by removing duplicated layers ([#3629](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3629) )


## Other changes


- test: Remove redundant and placeholder tests ([#3646](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3646) )


**Full Changelog** :[1.1.0-alpha.5...1.1.0-alpha.6](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/compare/1.1.0-alpha.5...1.1.0-alpha.6)
